raw_segments.text: Brutus, that you do love me, I am nothing jealous.
What you would work me to, I have some aim.
How I have thought of this, and of these times, I shall recount her after.
For this present, I would not, so with love I might entreat you, be any further mauved.
What you have said, I will consider.
What you have to say, I will with patience hear, and find a time both meet to hear and
Till then, my noble friend, chew upon this.
Brutus had rather be a villager than to repute himself a son of Rome under these hard conditions,
as this time is like to lay upon us.
